title: Wonderful sailing trip
text:
It was simply beautiful. 
Barcelona from the sea along with the sunset was simply incredibly beautiful. 
Many thanks once again to our dear skipper Leonardo. He made the sailing trip perfect.
author: Frank_B

title: Very practical sailing class
text: I attended a practical sailing class as a student (NEP-0012568). I loved it!!! The instructor from Neptune gives us the controls of the ship from the moment we set sail until we dock. I was able to perform all the maneuvers several times from all positions: at the helm, on the mainsail sheet, easing and trimming the genoa. Wonderful!!! We even did a "man overboard" drill practicing continuous tacks and jibes. The instructor explained everything. After so much repetition, in the end, the maneuvers even seem easy. And with the luxury of being in Barcelona. Incredible experience!!! Eager to repea

title: Enjoying the sea and friends
text:
Evaluation of the experience (August 9-15 by catamaran – Neptune Nautical School):
It's been an unforgettable journey. The companionship on board was excellent, creating an unbeatable Mood throughout the journey. The event, in general, I rate a 10, and the pattern was up to scratch throughout: professional, close and always attentive, it also deserves a 10. A highly recommended experience!

author: jumagahe11

title: On the Water - A Birthday Request - Booking for a Dear Friend
text:
A beautiful evening sail for 4. Our skipper was a wonderful host. He asked what kind of sail we were looking for/anticipating. My friend simply wanted to be on the water for her birthday. There were too many clouds to see the sun setting, but it didn’t change the value of the trip one bit. The location on the water was quiet, view of Barcelona was lovely, breeze was perfect and refreshing.  This sail was the perfect end to our very busy day tour of Barcelona. 
We highly recommend!!!
